supersedes.M11: calibration, now on the official split with an accuracy-invariance check
supersedes.M14: conformal, now reporting the empty-set rate rather than the guaranteed coverage

calibration.sanity_note: Temperature scaling is monotone, so accuracy MUST be unchanged. M11 reported accuracy moving 0.3573 -> 0.6595 under calibration, which means the comparison there was not like-for-like.

selective_prediction.note: AURC lower is better; no other model in the repo reports one.

clinical_operating_point.note: Sensitivity on test may fall below target - that gap is the honest result. A threshold re-tuned on test to hit the target would be the exact error the corrected protocol forbids.

conformal.reading: Empty-set rate on unknown patients is the detection number. If it is ~0 the wrapper detects nothing, no matter how good the coverage looks - this is the M14 conformal paradox stated correctly.
